name: process-efficiency-audit-20261026
description: Read-only project-wide process audit with a bounded dynamic agent pool, targeted follow-ups, independent Sol verification and evidence synthesis.
whenToUse: Explicit recommendation-only audit; replay with saved script, meta and arguments through the native Harness workflow tool.

phases.title: Parallel audit
phases.detail: Fourteen independent component/aspect assignments; reuse every available bounded slot.

phases.title: Targeted clarification
phases.detail: At most three report recoveries, confirmed transient retries or focused evidence clarifications, scheduled immediately per item.

phases.title: Independent verification
phases.detail: Three connected review domains, each with source checks, deduplication and no-finding samples.

phases.title: Targeted adjudication
phases.detail: At most two focused independent dispute resolutions, without restarting the audit.

phases.title: Evidence synthesis
phases.detail: Check files, structured evidence, source drift and coverage; save final English reports.
